simplicity.evaluation: Excellent - Each lesson has exactly ONE clear goal, consistently uses only 3 decision points, and provides clear guidance that a substitute could follow. Language is straightforward and practical.

progression.evaluation: Strong - Clear building from basic sound recognition to complex word creation and storytelling. Vocabulary spirals effectively (sounds→letters→families→sentences→stories). Shows clear growth trajectory from lesson 1-20.

authenticity.evaluation: Good - Supports teacher thinking with 'when things go wrong' guidance and flexible timing. Decision points acknowledge classroom unpredictability. Real-world connections are meaningful and age-appropriate.

substituteTeacherUsability.comments: Very clear lesson structure, minimal prep requirements, and explicit 'when things go wrong' guidance make this highly usable for substitute teachers.
